description: This file defines the TcpIoStream class which implements the IoStream interface for TCP network communication. It handles input/output streams, manages connection closure, and sets up a background thread for reading data from the socket, notifying a DataListener.

classes.name: TcpIoStream
classes.description: Implements IoStream for TCP socket communication, providing methods for writing, closing, and listening to incoming data, running the read loop asynchronously.

methods.name: TcpIoStream
methods.description: Constructor initializing input/output streams with null checks.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes data to the output stream and flushes it.

methods.name: purge
methods.description: Empty implementation, possibly for future extension.

methods.name: setInputListener
methods.description: Starts a background thread to read data from input stream and notify listener.

methods.name: isClosed
methods.description: Returns whether the stream has been closed.
